stages.name: receipt
needs: preserve existing summary and push actions

stages.name: stats
needs: atomic boundary and job enqueue under stopped writers
native absolute recalculation for every existing room and user
verify per-entity completion covers state delta boundary
review native processor/job concurrency in actual-image fixture before apply
stages.forbidden: standalone MAX seed without baseline rebuild

stages.name: directory
needs: native delete_all_from_user_dir clears derived search/visibility entries
native staging captures state delta boundary; cleanup publishes it
verify deltas arriving during staging are caught up after cleanup
stages.forbidden: NULL seed without complete native job chain

stages.name: forgetter
stages.forbidden: guess zero or MAX with unknown flag/leave candidates

sharedGuards: zero other database writers after coordinated stop
no helper UPDATE/overwrite or global table reset
preserve accounts/devices/E2EE keys/rooms/events; no token handling
separate per-stage receipt and rollback/resume decision
